senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. דמם, דבב)to mumble; to meditate, plan (mostly in an evil sense, cmp. דִּבָּה).—Part. זוֹמֵם planning evil, esp. (with ref. to Deut. XIX, 19)
giving false testimony, amenable to the law of retaliation;
senses.label: a

units: Tosef. Macc. I, 1 עד ז׳ a witness convicted of false testimony; a. fr.—Fem. זוֹמֶמֶת (sub. עדות).
<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 1:9">Macc. I, 9</cite> <he>נמצאת אחת מהן ז׳</he> if one evidence (of one set of witnesses) has been disproved; a. e.—Pl. <he>זוֹמְמִין</he>, <he>זוֹמְמִים</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 1:4">Ib. 4</cite> <he>אין אלו ז׳</he> they do not come under the law of retaliation.

<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 1:4">Ib.</cite> <he>נעשים ז׳</he> are declared amenable to the law &c.; a. fr.—Tosef. ib. I, 10 <he>זוֹמְמֵיהֶן</he> those witnesses on whose evidence they had been declared guilty of false testimony. Y. ib. I, beg. 31ᵃ <he>זוֹמְמָיו</he> those who witnessed falsely against him.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 8:2">Tosef. Snh. VIII, 2</cite> <he>העדים וזוממיהן וזוֹמְמֵי זוממיהן</he> the original witnesses and their refuters, and the refuters of their refuters; a. fr.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to make a person a זוֹמֵם, to refute witnesses by testifying to an alibi, to rebut.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 1:5">Macc. I, 5</cite> if other witnesses came again <he>והֵזֵימּוּם</he> and rebutted them.
<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 1:4">Macc. I, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Makkot 5a:4">5ᵃ</cite>) <he>שיזימו</he> Bab. ed., read <he>שיזומו</he>, v. infra.

senses.gloss: to be refuted, to be declared liable to the law of retaliation.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 10a:8">Snh. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>פלוני … והוּזַמּוּ</he> if witnesses declared, This man did &c., and were declared guilty &c.
<cite ref="Makkot 3a:5">Macc. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>הוּזַמְּנוּ וכ׳</he> we have been convicted &c. before that certain court, and made to pay.

<cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 1:4">Ib. I, 4</cite> <he>עד שיִזּוֹמּוּ את עצמן</he> (Ar. <he>בעצמן</he>, Bab. ed. <he>שיזימו</he> corr. acc.) unless an alibi is established against their own persons (not an alibi of any of the alleged actors in the case). Ib. 5ᵇ <he>עד שיזומו שניהם</he> unless both of them are refuted; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to rebut. Part. מְזַמֵּם, pl. מְזַמְּמִין, contr. מְזַמִּים. Y. ib. I, 31ᵇ top.—Part. pass. מְזוּמָּם one accused by false witnesses.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:2">Snh. VI, 2</cite> <he>אם היה יודע שהוא מ׳</he> if he knew that he was innocent.

senses.gloss: to be refuted &c., v. Hof. Y. Macc. I, beg. 31ᵃ נִזְדַּמְּמוּ = נִיזוֹמּוּ.

units: Gen. R. s. 81, beg. (ref. to זמות, Prov. XXX, 32) אם נִזְדַּמְּמוּ אחריך דברים וכ׳ (Yalk. Prov. 964 נִזְמְמוּ Nif.) if thou hast been slandered, put thy hand to thy mouth; v. זָמַם II.—Denom. זְמָם I.
